# Heytap Mobile
> Heytap Mobile provides mobile internet services, app distribution, developer tools, and cloud capabilities for OPPO ecosystem users and partners.

This site spans consumer services and developer-facing platforms, including app publishing, push notifications, in-app services, account integration, analytics, and cloud messaging for OPPO and related devices.

## Main Site
- [Heytap Mobile Home](https://www.heytapmobile.com/): Main portal for Heytap Mobile services, products, and ecosystem information.
- [About](https://www.heytapmobile.com/about): Overview of Heytap Mobile company background and service scope.
- [Contact](https://www.heytapmobile.com/contact): Contact information and support entry points for business and service inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.heytapmobile.com/privacy): Privacy practices governing Heytap Mobile products and services.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.heytapmobile.com/agreement): General terms and conditions for using Heytap Mobile services.

## Developer Platform
- [OPPO Developers](https://open.oppomobile.com/): Central developer portal for OPPO and Heytap platform integration and publishing.
- [Developer Console](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10288): Entry point to developer documentation and platform capabilities.
- [Documentation Center](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/index): Product documentation, integration guides, and service references.
- [Service Overview](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11241): Overview of developer services available across the OPPO ecosystem.
- [Developer Registration](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10142): Guidance for creating and verifying a developer account.

## App Distribution
- [App Market Access Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10269): Instructions for submitting and managing apps in the OPPO App Market.

- [App Update Management](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10271): Procedures for version updates and release maintenance.
- [App Review Specifications](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10272): Compliance and review requirements for app approval.
- [Game Center Access Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10273): Publishing and operating games within the OPPO ecosystem.

## Push and Messaging
- [Push Service Overview](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11228): Introduction to OPPO push notification capabilities and use cases.
- [Push Integration Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11229): Setup instructions for integrating push services into apps.
- [Push API Reference](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11230): API details for sending and managing push notifications.
- [Message Classification](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11231): Definitions and rules for notification and transmission message types.
- [Push Troubleshooting](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11232): Common issues and debugging guidance for push delivery.

## Account and User Identity

- [OAuth Authorization](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10276): Authorization flow and token handling for account access.
- [User Information Access](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10277): Methods for retrieving authorized user profile information.
- [Account FAQ](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10278): Frequently asked questions about account service integration.
